payload.blocks: Only phase 4 (the last) of plan 0016. Phases 1-3 are landed; its lead is live and waiting.
payload.headline: Who runs phase 4's live check of plan 0016 on fg-server? It kills a supervisor and stops the watcher

parts.cause: A lead may not start or stop sessions, and my confined session cannot kill processes or stop a systemd user unit. The only unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR is on fg-server2, a different machine, so it cannot check fg-server's scopes.

options.does: The unconfined session you open on fg-server for the dying-leads diagnosis also runs these five steps and writes live-check.md.
options.gain: One session, one visit; both checks touch the same run-supervisor scope code.
options.harm: Phase 4 waits until that session exists.
options.label: Same unconfined session as q-o4i37jakak

options.does: You run the five steps in a terminal on fg-server and paste the output into live-check.md.
options.harm: Your time, and you kill a process yourself.
options.label: You run the steps by hand

options.does: Plan 0016 stays running with phase 4 parked until an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR exists on fg-server.
options.harm: The failure-domain fix is unproven live and the plan does not close.
options.label: Park phase 4

parts.recommendation: Fold it into the unconfined fg-server session of q-o4i37jakak.

scope.allows: Killing one run supervisor and stopping the fgos-watcher user unit on fg-server for this check only.
scope.forbids: Touching fg-server2, other heads' sessions, or any code change.

parts.what: Plan 0016 phase 4 is a live check on fg-server: start two heads, confirm each sits in its own fgos-run-*.scope, kill -9 one run supervisor and see session-gone/supervisor-gone, stop the fgos-watcher unit and see both sockets still answer. Results go to plans/261127-0016-head-run-own-failure-domain/reports/live-check.md; the lead lands phase 4 after.
